name: Oklo Inc.
content: Oklo Inc. is an advanced fission technology company focused on developing fast fission reactors to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale. The company designs and builds the Aurora powerhouse, a micro-reactor capable of generating power from recycled nuclear fuel as well as fresh fuel. By utilizing a fast neutron spectrum, Oklo aims to reduce nuclear waste and enhance energy efficiency. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Oklo is pioneering a business model that involves selling power directly to customers through long-term power purchase agreements, targeting data centers, industrial sites, and remote communities.

Officers

Jacob DeWitteJanuary 2013

Chief Executive Officer

Dr. Jacob DeWitte is the co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of Oklo. He has been a director of Oklo since its inception in 2013. Dr. DeWitte has experience in the nuclear industry, working on reactor design and strategy. He holds a Ph.D. in Nuclear Engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

Caroline CochranJanuary 2013

Chief Operating Officer

Caroline Cochran is the co-founder and Chief Operating Officer of Oklo. She has been a director of Oklo since its inception in 2013. She has experience in operations and risk management. She holds an M.S. in Nuclear Engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and a B.A. in Economics and B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Oklahoma.

Craig BealmearJanuary 2024

Chief Financial Officer

R. Craig Bealmear has served as Oklo’s Chief Financial Officer since 2024. Prior to joining Oklo, he served as the Chief Financial Officer of Renewable Energy Group, Inc. and spent over 24 years at BP in various finance and leadership roles.

Chris Wright2022

Member of the Board of Directors

Chris Wright has served as a director of Oklo since May 2024. He is the Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of Liberty Energy Inc.

Jack HerlihyMay 2024

Director

Jack Herlihy has served as a director of Oklo since May 2024. He was previously the Vice President of EMEA and Latin America at LinkedIn and held various roles at Google.
